name: harmless_extraction
note: Control set, index-matched to harmful.json. Entry i mirrors the grammatical frame and length of harmful entry i ("Explain how X works, from a Y's perspective", "What techniques do X use in Y", ...) while being unambiguously benign. Matching matters: if the two sets differed in form as well as content, the difference-of-means direction would partly encode sentence shape, and the ablation result would be far less interpretable.
